guards.why: SEAM RESERVATION -- the pour's own narrowest waist

note: D-695: the C24.1 / C26.2 seam of the BQ25185_SYS B.Cu pour, 0.7074 mm at its narrowest between (62.605,103.845) and (63.008,104.426).  Any foreign conductor laid across it cuts the pour in two and costs the net an edge; this reserves it so a re-routed Net-(U12-PS_SYNC) cannot put the same cut back.
